title: Members of the Kid Albert and Barnes band
summary: Vincent lists the six men in the Kid Albert and Barnes band, including Joe Struttis, Ory Foster and himself, and says they played for a Jewish organisation.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I'm asking who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band.

He said, who was in the Kid Albert and Barnes band? Well, Kid Albert, Barnes, Donna Handler. And the first part of Sean, they paid drum. Yeah, he lost his mind. He's in the K-Dow too. Then we got Joe Struttis and myself. Then we had Ory Foster. Ory Foster come up to the Muslim white people and had a step on a drum. And like two times, we had to get to play the Ory. And, uh, and R.C. Parisey. We had, um, we had six men.
Which bonds was that? A Jewish bond.
